{{Top|leg}}
'''Mon duuls''' were creatures of four [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]] of weight used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. If planted with special [[villip]]s, they used the tympanic membranes that stretched over their bodies as loudspeakers.
